text:
Maria: Uploaded a new pass for dark theme. Main goals: reduce retinal fatigue on long dashboards, keep syntax pop, and keep chart colors distinct when stacked. Screenshot: https://redwood.assets/mockups/dark-pass-v7.png
Josh: saw it — nice. Quick q: are we keeping console bg at #0b0d10 or moving to #0e1013? contrast with code gutter felt low.
Maria: leaning #0e1013. Gutter we can darken to #0b0c0e. It's mostly a spatial separation, not contrast for text.
Aria: for syntax, keywords should be more saturated. Current blue (#5FB0FF) feels washed on #0e1013. Try #7FD3FF or #6EC6FF.
Kevin: accessibility nit — need 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text. Are we tracking token counts in the console? (screenshot)
Maria: yes baseline text is 14px/16px normal. We'll run a contrast scan.
Design-Bot: Contrast scan complete. Flagged 3 items failing WCAG 2.1 AA: 'muted-comment' (#6b6f73 on #0e1013), 'chart-axes' (#777b7f on #0e1013), 'secondary-button-text' (#9aa0a6 on #0b0c0e).
Josh: for charts — stacked area uses teal/orange/green. Teal and green are too close in luminance when #0e1013 bg. Suggest increasing green saturation or switching to magenta.
Aria: +1 to swapping green to magenta for color-blind safe palette. Also prefer outline on hover rather than glow to avoid bloom on OLED.
Kevin: for syntax tokens, can we bold function names and lower emphasis for strings? might help scannability.
Maria: prototype attached. CSS variables updated:
```
--bg: #0e1013
--surface-muted: #0b0c0e
--syntax-keyword: #7fd3ff
--syntax-fn: #c9f0ff
--syntax-string: #b8e38a
--chart-green: #e06ab0 /* magenta-ish */
```
Josh: looks promising. Quick perf note — shadows/glows on many small chips cause GPU overdraw on mobile. prefer 1px outline.
Aria: copy tweak: change 'Enable compact mode' tooltip to 'Reduce vertical spacing to see more rows'. clearer.
Kevin: last call — run Lighthouse contrast checks and add a regression test in Percy for the key views.
Maria: done. I'll put a PR for the CSS vars + accessibility tests. Thanks team :sparkles:
Josh: LGTM :thumbsup:
Aria: :eyes:
Design-Bot: PR 452 landed in branch/theme/dark-refactor — deploy preview available: https://staging.redwood-inference/ui/preview/452
